title: The War Council
description: Dusek has assembled the general staff. Tyvaren is not bluffing. Military options are on the table — defensive postures, mobilization frameworks, the shape of what comes next.

title: The Strevna Negotiations
description: Foreign Minister Volkov has agreed to talks at neutral Strevna. The Tyvaren delegation is waiting. Whatever comes out of this room shapes whether there is a war.

title: Budget Allocation — War or Peace Framework
description: The budget looks different depending on whether the Strevna talks succeed. Prepare both frameworks. You'll need the right one within hours of knowing the outcome.

title: Vyktor — The Parting Gift
description: Vyktor chose a cafe, not a government building. Old wood, afternoon light. He's brought something — not a folder this time. He says it's the last piece of information he can give you before he goes.

title: Dravenni — Military Coordination
description: The DLF has responded to your outreach. They're willing to coordinate — but coordination means treating them as allies, not subjects. Brenner has concerns. Dusek has operational questions.

title: Superpower Response — Alliance Expectations
description: Whichever power you aligned with is now calling in the investment. Arcturians want trade concessions. Orythians want basing rights. Both want an answer before the crisis resolves without them.

title: BCA Report
description: The Bureau of Civic Accountability has submitted its second report.

title: SSD Report
description: The State Security Directorate has submitted its second report.
